# 4 bed detached house for sale

> ***OPEN VIEWING WEDNESDAY 2ND SEP 18:00-18:30*** DNG Rathfarnham are pleased to present 5 Orchardton to the market. This impressive detached four-bedroom family home offers excellent space in a quiet cul-de-sac position opposite a lovely communal green. A substantial property of approximately 130 square metres 5 Orchardton boasts well laid out accommodation spread across two floors.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 130 m²
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: 5 Orchardton, Rathfarnham
- Cena: 795 000 €
